ANKIT KUMAR JAIN BUSINESS ANALYST | CAPITAL MARKETS

Pune, India | +91 8817469596 | ankit.jain14@gmail.com | LinkedIn: ankit-jain-70547783

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Business Analyst with 9 years of experience, including strong Capital Markets exposure across Corporate Actions, Settlement, Trade Lifecycle, Equities, Fixed Income, FX and Derivatives. Experienced in end-to-end requirements management, BRD/FRD, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, process mapping, UAT and Agile/Scrum delivery. Worked with Front Office, Legal, Custodian, Fund Administration and Technology stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional solutions. Additional experience includes margin calls, collateral movements, equity research and multi-asset financial modelling.

CORE SKILLS

Business Analysis: Requirement Gathering, BRD/FRD, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Gap Analysis, AS-IS/TO-BE, Process Mapping

Capital Markets: Corporate Actions, Settlement, Trade Lifecycle, Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives

Agile & Delivery: Agile, Scrum, JIRA, Backlog Management, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, UAT, RAID/Dependency Tracking, Release Management, SDLC

Stakeholder Management: Front Office, Technology, Legal, Custodian, Fund Administration, Clients, Brokers, Counterparties

Data & Analysis: SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel, Financial Modelling

Controls & Operations: Business Rules, Validation Logic, Exception Handling, Maker-Checker Controls, Audit Trails, Operational Risk Reduction

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Citco Fund Services | Business Analyst | Jun 2021 – Present • Gather and analyze business requirements for Capital Markets initiatives covering Corporate Actions and Settlement within

Hedge Fund (Fund of Fund) operations.

Translate business requirements into BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria,

maintaining traceability from business needs through implementation.

Perform AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, gap analysis and process mapping across the trade lifecycle to identify automation and

process improvement opportunities.

Define business rules and validation logic for key economic and transaction parameters including trade date, settlement

date, market value, payment details and transaction processing.

Work with Front Office, Legal, Custodian, Fund Administration and Technology stakeholders to analyze trade lifecycle

impacts and agree on functional solutions.

Own BA activities across requirement elicitation, impact analysis, solution discussions, development support, UAT,

business sign-off and implementation.

Work in an Agile/Scrum environment, participating in Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews

and Retrospectives; manage requirements and backlog items through JIRA.

Support maker-checker workflows, exception handling and rejection controls, and validate audit-trail functionality including

timestamps, user activity and field-level change tracking.

Manage user stories and backlog priorities based on business priorities, dependencies and delivery timelines; track risks,

issues and dependencies and support governance reporting.

Support UAT through business scenarios, test coverage review, defect tracking, business-user coordination and validation

of delivered solutions against approved requirements.

Coordinate with Front Office, Legal, Custodian and Fund Administration teams to investigate custody breaks, settlement

exceptions and system discrepancies.

Develop SOPs, business process documentation and process flow diagrams to support operational consistency and

knowledge transfer.

eClerx Services Ltd. | Analyst | May 2019 – Apr 2021

• Managed margin calls within agreed timelines and researched, reconciled and resolved margin-call disputes with

counterparties.

Confirmed and processed collateral movements to support smooth post-trade operations. • Communicate with clients, brokers and custodians on trade confirmations and operational queries via phone, email and conferences.

Performed root-cause analysis of operational errors and proposed or implemented controls in coordination with

supervisors and managers.

SG Analytics | Associate Analyst | Aug 2017 – Jun 2018 • Developed an equity research financial model from scratch, ensuring accuracy and alignment with client requirements. • Transferred a financial model from another database system to improve data accessibility and efficiency. • Created and analyzed financial models across Equities, Commodities, Economics, Fixed Income and Currency asset

classes.

Led a 5–6-member team project and coordinated deliverables to meet agreed deadlines.

Infosys BPO Ltd. | Senior Accountant | Jun 2014 – Jan 2016 • Worked in accounting operations; further role details are not provided in the source of CV.

EDUCATION

MBA/PGDM, 2017 — School of Economics, DAVV, Indore • BCom, 2014 — Indore Indira School of Career Studies, Indore

CERTIFICATIONS

Financial Modeling • IT Business Analyst Training

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Languages: English, Hindi

Location: Pune, India
